# Clínica de Acupuntura Dra Tamara

> A comprehensive acupuncture clinic in São Paulo specializing in pain management, fertility, mental health, and traditional Chinese medicine based on WHO-recognized treatments.

Dra Tamara's clinic in Jardim Marajoara, Santo Amaro offers over 15 years of experience in acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine, treating a wide range of conditions from chronic pain and neurological disorders to fertility and aesthetic concerns. The clinic emphasizes evidence-based acupuncture supported by WHO research and scientific studies.

## Tratamentos por Condição

- [Tratamentos de Acupuntura Segundo OMS](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/tratamentos-de-acupuntura): Comprehensive guide to conditions treated by acupuncture per WHO standards and recognized indications
- [Dores Crônicas e Analgesia](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/analgesia-dores-cronicas-dolorosas): Treatment for chronic pain conditions including arthritis, fibromyalgia, and migraines
- [Estresse, Ansiedade e Insônia](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/estresse-ansiedade-irritabilidade): Acupuncture treatment for stress, anxiety, panic syndrome, and sleep disorders
- [Doenças Neurológicas](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/neurologia-avc-parkinson-enxaqueca): Neurological disease treatment including Parkinson's, stroke, migraines, and facial paralysis
- [Alergias Respiratórias e Vertigo](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/crises-agudas-alergia-respiratoria): Treatment for respiratory allergies, asthma, skin conditions, and vertigo disorders
- [Ginecologia e Fertilidade](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/beneficios-na-ginecologia-e-fertilidade): Gynecological and fertility treatment including infertility, endometriosis, and menopause
- [Problemas Urológicos e Sexuais](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/problema-sexual-urologia-prostatite): Urological and sexual dysfunction treatment including prostatitis and urinary incontinence
- [Doenças Cardiovasculares](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/doenca-cardiovascular-hipertensao): Cardiovascular treatment for hypertension, high blood pressure, and vascular diseases
- [Distúrbios Digestivos](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/doencas-digestivo-gastrointestinais): Digestive and gastrointestinal disorders treatment including GERD, diabetes, and constipation
- [Acupuntura Oncológica](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/doencas-sangue-dor-cancer): Oncological acupuncture for cancer pain and chemotherapy side effects management

## Acupuntura Especializada

- [Acupuntura Estética](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/acupuntura-estetica-acne-manchas): Facial and body aesthetic acupuncture for skin rejuvenation, acne, and anti-aging treatments
- [Acupuntura Esportiva](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/desempenho-esportivo-lesoes-traumas): Sports acupuncture for athletic performance enhancement and injury recovery

- [Benefícios da Acupuntura](https://www.acupunturadratamara.com.br/beneficios-da-acupuntura): Scientific research on acupuncture benefits for physical and mental health regulation
